page: Alibaba Cloud ecs.g9a.48xlarge is a general-purpose virtual machine instance powered by the KVM hypervisor. It features 192 dedicated vCPUs utilizing the x86_64 architecture, driven by AMD EPYC 9T25 processors operating at a base clock speed of 2.7 GHz. The instance is equipped with 768.0 GB of system memory, maintaining a balanced ratio of 4.0 GB of RAM per vCPU.

This instance does not include local storage, requiring external block storage solutions for data persistence. It provides a high-capacity network interface with a baseline bandwidth of 96 Gbps, facilitating rapid data transfers and low-latency communication across distributed environments. From a qualitative cost-efficiency perspective, the high density of dedicated AMD EPYC cores and substantial memory capacity allows organizations to consolidate multiple smaller workloads into a single large-scale environment, optimizing resource utilization without the overhead of local storage maintenance.

Given its balanced compute-to-memory ratio and high network throughput, the ecs.g9a.48xlarge is designed for demanding enterprise-grade applications. It is highly suitable for large-scale web serving, application servers, enterprise databases, containerized microservices, and continuous integration and continuous deployment (CI/CD) pipelines that require massive parallel processing capabilities.
